items.text: After testing negative multiple times last week, including yesterday, this morning I woke up with mild cold symptoms and have tested positive for Covid. I’ll be working from home this week and my offices remain open.
I'm proud to bring over $1.5 million back to the 8th in necessary water treatment upgrades. https://t.co/0nIHqxN51f

Tonight I was glad to vote for the Ensuring Lasting Smiles Act to make sure insurance companies are held accountable for covering medically necessary treatment for children born with birth defects. Removing a barrier to treatment and making sure kids get the care they need!

I had a wonderful time at Sammamish Plateau Water to celebrate the federal funding I was able to secure for a water treatment plant upgrades. This new upgrade will help expand clean drinking water resources for the community. https://t.co/7PB0WpZ0Tc

Today @RepDustyJohnson & I sent a letter to FDA about the baby formula shortage. No parent should have to worry about being able to feed their newborn. When there is a voluntary recall of essential nutrition impacting the whole nation, we need to ensure quick action can be taken. https://t.co/X7wxcD401d

When there is a voluntary recall of essential nutrition impacting the nation, we need to ensure quick action can be taken. https://t.co/uTrSZKEpfD

Yesterday I held a virtual roundtable with WA nutrition and SNAP advocates to help inform the upcoming White House Conference on Hunger. A special thank you to my @HouseAgDems colleague and nutrition champion @RepMcGovern for joining our roundtable and bringing his expertise. https://t.co/dDyo66S4xB
To learn more about the signs and symptoms of RSV, visit https://t.co/DUsF21230K or talk with your pediatrician.

Thank you to everyone who came out to my first town hall in Granite Falls! It was helpful to hear about issues like investing in the wastewater treatment facility, public safety, and increasing internet access. Also, a special thank you to Mayor Hartman for moderating. https://t.co/GHJ2fb1ZHx

All Americans should have access to a nutritious diet.

To make this a reality and support local farmers, @‌RepBonamici and I introduced the EAT Act, a commonsense update to TEFAP that will provide vulnerable families with healthy, fresh produce. https://t.co/IVIeSeRhDN

Glad to work alongside my @NewDemCoalition colleagues to put forward commonsense, bipartisan legislation to bolster our agriculture economy, secure essential nutrition programs, and support rural communities.

I recently visited the newly opened Ideal Option addiction treatment center, where I met with staff and learned about the treatment they provide in our region for those struggling with addiction. https://t.co/zzr6BWlJr9

As a pediatrician, I know that children's nutrition impacts everything from physical development to classroom performance.

That's why I introduced the Whole Milk for Healthy Kids Act to allow 2% whole milk in public schools so that kids get the essential nutrients they need. https://t.co/38TV1aD3ip

Great news: Today my bill, the Whole Milk for Healthy Kids Act, passed the House by a vote of 330-99!

This bipartisan bill will help improve children’s nutrition by allowing whole milk to be served in public schools. Read more below:
https://t.co/d5TQOFHxh3

I believe everyone should have access to cancer education, prevention, treatment, and care - no matter where you live, your income, your ethnicity, or gender. This #WorldCancerDay I’m speaking up to #CloseTheCareGap. https://t.co/JBwZ6wCLAN

As our children face an unprecedented mental health crisis, Congress must act.

That's why I introduced legislation with @RepUnderwood to increase the number of medical professionals receiving suicide prevention and lethal means education.

President Trump's federal funding freeze disrupted millions of dollars for Medicaid and substance abuse prevention and treatment programs in Washington State.

These programs and others are key to combatting the fentanyl crisis and addressing emerging threats like xylazine, and halting their funding is dangerous.
